name: Bell Bridge v0.3 Freeze

scope.implemented_fact: The Bell/CHSH reference sidecar, B1/B2 local candidates, B3.1 joint-closure candidate, B3.2 geometry audit, B3.2.1 null failure localization, and B3.2.2 semantic/refinement provenance audit exist as reproducible artifacts.
scope.design_choice: Freeze the current HAOS-IIP-to-Bell candidate branch as a negative result rather than continuing diagnostics around the same object.
scope.heuristic: The current G / J_lambda construction produces genuine relational structure but does not establish HAOS-specific provenance.
scope.unverified_hypothesis: No HAOS-IIP Bell derivation is established.

prohibited_continuations: do not continue to B3.3 using the same G construction
do not continue to B3.3 using the same J_lambda construction
do not retune setting mappings, thresholds, beta, signs, or normalization for the current branch
do not compute CHSH from the terminal B3.2.2 branch
do not claim HAOS-IIP derives Bell correlations from these artifacts
allowed_future_work: start a new Bell branch only with a new precommitment
supply a new mechanism with independent provenance
create a fresh assumption ledger before any Bell scoring
calibrate the instrument on a synthetic relational-geometry suite before returning to physics bridges
durable_statement: The current G / J_lambda construction produces genuine relational structure, but not structure specific enough to support a HAOS-IIP Bell bridge.
